definition: ERS Operating costs and Allocated overhead category components sum to the published category total. Nested subtotal rows are excluded when present.
source_locator: ERS documentation, Cost-of-Production Estimates; Corn U.S. total 2025 category/item labels in pinned CSV
rounding_rule: Each component and total is published to cents; maximum difference (number of components + 1) * 0.005 dollars per planted acre, fixed before comparison execution.

components: Capital recovery of machinery and equipment
